guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails at the step where it attempts to download and install Mambaforge. Specifically, the wget command to https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Mambaforge-Linux-x86_64.sh results in a 404 Not Found error. This indicates that the URL is broken or the file has been moved or removed. To fix this, the Dockerfile needs to be updated with a valid and current URL for the Mambaforge installation script. It is recommended to verify the latest stable version of Mambaforge for Linux x86_64 from the official conda-forge or Miniforge repositories and update the wget URL accordingly. Once this is resolved, the Dockerfile should be rebuilt.
guidance_for_write_eval_script_agent: The current evaluation script attempts to activate the conda environment using 'source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh', but the Dockerfile installs Mambaforge under '/opt/mambaforge'. This mismatch in conda installation paths will cause environment activation to fail if the Dockerfile is fixed and built successfully. Update the eval script to activate conda from '/opt/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh' instead of '/opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh'. Also ensure that the eval script properly echoes the exit code 'OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc' as currently implemented.
